page.overview:
Who is Apharan?

Apharan is the current Warden of the Rock for the Dark Angels Chapter of Space Marines.

He oversees the garrison forces known as the "Knights of the Rock" who defend the Dark Angels' mobile fortress-monastery, The Rock.
